rationale: The agent did attempt basic authentication (lookup by name and ZIP) and retrieved user details and order info. However, it executed order-changing actions without explicit user confirmation: it called modify_pending_order_items to exchange the laptop and cancel_pending_order for an order, both prior to confirming with the user. The policy requires confirming every order-changing action before taking it. Additionally, there’s no clear confirmation that the correct pending five-item order was identified before cancellation, nor any confirmation of the desired configuration (i9 with 256GB SSD and silver). The final user-facing message provides no summary of actions taken or results. These issues violate the stated policy, so the outcome fails.
